newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle $0.50-1.00 higher - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle $0.50-1.00 higher - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers active. Both classes $0.50-1.00 higher. - USDA

Slaughter Steers: Part load Choice 3 high dressing old crop near 1450 lbs 66.50. High Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 64.00-66.00, some white face 63.00. Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 63.00-64.00. Select 1-2 62.00-63.00.
Slaughter Heifers: High Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1200 lbs 63.50-66.00. Select and Choice 2-3 950-1100 lbs 62.50-63.50. Select 1-2 61.50-62.50.
